newMessage.title: Welcome line for new chatters
newMessage.description: {name} becomes the viewer's name and {platform} the platform. One line is picked at random from this and the extra lines.
newMessage.default: Welcome in, {name}! First time in chat, so make yourself at home.

newMessageAlternates.title: Extra welcome lines
newMessageAlternates.description: One per line. Each greeting picks one of these or the line above at random.
default: Hey {name}, so glad you found us! Pull up a seat and hang out.
{name} just said hi for the first time. Welcome to the crew!

greetReturning.title: Greet returning chatters too
greetReturning.description: Viewers who chatted in an earlier stream get the welcome-back line.

returningMessage.title: Welcome-back line
returningMessage.description: {name} becomes the viewer's name, {since} when they last came (for example 3 days ago) and {visits} which stream this is for them (for example 5th).
returningMessage.default: Welcome back, {name}! Last time we saw you was {since}.

returningMessageAlternates.title: Extra welcome-back lines
returningMessageAlternates.description: One per line. Lines with {since} or {visits} are skipped for viewers StreamBridge has no history for yet.
default: {name} is here for their {visits} stream with us. Good to see you!
Hey {name}, missed you since {since}. Your seat is still warm.

showChatMessage.title: Show their first message in the bubble

skipNames.title: Never greet these names
skipNames.description: Comma-separated, for example your bot accounts. Bots and your own account are always skipped.

resetHours.title: New stream after this many quiet hours
resetHours.description: Everyone can be greeted again when a stream starts, or after chat has been quiet this long.

allowOptOut.title: Let viewers turn off their own greeting
allowOptOut.description: A viewer types the command once to stop being greeted, and again to turn it back on.

confirmOptOut.title: Confirm in chat
confirmOptOut.description: Replies in chat so the viewer knows it worked.
